notes.title: Bug in the store within the game corrected
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

We've solved the bug mentioned on the last update, and we've just reuploaded the HD version, now with the store within the game working properly.

notes.title: Serious bug in the store inside the game
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

There's a pretty serious bug in the store in the latest version. Until we solve it, we decided to reupload a previous version, still with SD graphics, but without any bugs in the store.

As soon as we solve it, we'll reupload the newest version with HD graphics.

All the best, and sorry for that.

notes.title: HD images, full controller support on selection screens
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

By far, the biggest news in this update is the fact that we replaced about 80% of the images in the game, using newer ones with bigger resolution. Because of that, the game now looks much better in HD and Full HD resolutions, especially the bosses and the opening / ending sequences.

It's definitely been a huge amount of work in the last month and a half, but I guess it was worth it. We hope you'll enjoy it.

We also added full controller support on the main menu, jukebox, language selection and difficulty selection.

And last but not least, we corrected some nasty little bugs that were pretty hard to find. ;)

notes.title: Hell Pages Jukebox and some finetuning
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

The biggest news in this update is the inclusion of the Hell Pages Jukebox. You can access it through the "Soundtrack" option on the main menu. Then you'll be able to listen to all music tracks contained in Hell Pages original soundtrack.

Besides that, there were some other adjustments:

- Bael, the main character, now has a little blinking red area, which shows his hitbox.

- When pressing "ESC" to pause game, now you can choose between exit to main menu ou return to gameplay.

- The "hand" controlling with keyboard and gamepad on the main menu and select areas is smoother now, as the "hand" speed has been reduced. There's no change when using mouse, though.

- When pressing the "F" key, you can toggle between fullscreen and windowed mode on any part of the game.

- When playing in "Easy", now you'll be able to collect, on every single stage, little flasks that restore automatically all your energy and magic.
